geometry.description: Right circular copper (Cu-plated stainless) barrel with a single copper (Cu-plated stainless, hollow) tuning rod parallel to the axis. The rod rotates about an off-axis axle: the axle axis is 0.475 in from BOTH the cavity axis and the rod axis, so the rod-centre distance from the cavity axis is d(theta) = 2*0.475 in*sin(theta/2) (0 at theta = 0, rod concentric; 0.95 in at theta = 180 deg, rod 0.05 in from the wall). The axle is a 0.25 in OD alumina tube on each end (steel spindle inside the rod body) passing through the endcaps into turrets. The CST model: copper rod, 0.010 in gaps on either side, 0.25 in OD alumina axles at the pivot point, vacuum, copper background.

conventions.form_factor_definition: C = (int E_z dV)^2 / (V int eps_r |E|^2 dV), B0 uniform along z. 2006.01248 (Eq. 12 + Sec. II.C + footnote 21): V = volume NOT occupied by metal (vacuum + dielectric) -> for the one-rod cavity V_vac = 1.5455e-3 m^3. 1809.02246 Eq. 3 is the same formula with only 'V is the cavity volume' (convention NOT stated: could be V_vac or the full barrel V_full = pi R^2 H = 2.0593e-3 m^3; ratio V_full/V_vac = 1.3324). Footnote 21 of 2006.01248 says older HAYSTAC/ADMX numbers used V including metal: C_full = C_vac * V_vac/V_full. axionFEM must report BOTH C_vac and C_full for every HAYSTAC comparison. E.g. Fig. 6c 0.751 (C_vac) -> C_full = 0.564, which MOSTLY (not fully: 12% residual) accounts for 1611.07123 'C010 ~ 0.5'
conventions.Q_definition: Q = omega U / P_d, U = (eps0/2) int |E|^2 dV, P_d = (omega mu delta/4) oint |H|^2 dA (classical skin depth) [2006.01248 Eqs. 7-10]. Fig. 6b Q is taken to be the UNLOADED simulated Q - INFERRED (eigenmode solver, no ports mentioned), not stated in the paper
conventions.figure_of_merit: Q C^2 V^2 in m^6 (Fig. 6a), V in m^3
conventions.notes: Fig. 3 rod-rotation axis assumed identical to 1809.02246 phi (0 = concentric, 180 = nearest wall); not stated explicitly in 2006.01248 but Fig. 3 has its maximum TM010 frequency at 0 deg and the text says the rod 'is rotated away from the center of the cavity'.

curves.description: Simulated (CST MWS eigenmode) TM010-like branch of the one-rod HAYSTAC Phase I/II cavity vs rod rotation (0 deg = rod concentric, max frequency). Near theta = 0 the figure has two parallel steep lines (13-40 MHz apart); they are recorded as two separate series. Series 0 = lower line = TM010-like (caption: lowest-frequency TM mode); series 1 = upper parallel line (not TM010-like; identity unknown, plausibly TM011-like: the coax TM011 offset sqrt(f^2 + (c/2H)^2) - f is ~30 MHz).

series.label: TM010-like (lower of the two parallel lines; lowest steeply tuning TM branch)
series.note: theta <= 23 deg: marker centroids (0.01-deg abscissae, raster-quantized 0.5-deg steps); theta >= 24: 1-deg median bins. 14.5-19.5 deg ambiguous (+/-0.03 GHz).

series.label: upper parallel steep line (NOT TM010-like), theta 0.3-14 deg
series.note: traced only where unambiguous; merges into the crossing cluster beyond ~14 deg

f_theta0.basis: markers at theta = 0 are hidden under the frame line; their right arms are visible at f = 5.835 (lower) and 5.850 (upper), and the 0.5-deg markers read 5.8349 / 5.8464-5.8483: both lines are flat at the top (f even in theta), so f(0) = f(0.5 deg) within 1 px. Branch separation grows 14 -> 27 -> 33 -> ~40 MHz at 0 / 4 / 9.5 / 14 deg.
f_theta0.benchmark_target: f_TM010-like(theta = 0) = 5.835 GHz on the lower line; quote 5.83-5.85 GHz with +/-0.015 GHz target tolerance (line assignment, axles, CST mesh unknown)

digitization.method: raster, as above, but for theta <= 23 deg on individual marker centroids: every isolated 5-px '+' marker (connected dark component, area <= 9 px, theta = 0 frame column masked) whose centroid lies within 0.007 GHz (~2 px) of the branch's own PCHIP guide; one point per 0.5-deg simulation step; theta is the raw centroid (raster-quantized, so steps read e.g. 1.44/1.86/2.47 deg). Markers merged with flat intruder lines are skipped (gaps). For theta > 23 deg the 1-deg median binning of the dark-run cloud (original method) is kept.
digitization.uncertainty_basis: two-branch region: +/-1 px marker centroid -> +/-0.2 deg (raster quantization of the 0.5-deg step), +/-0.0034 GHz + calibration 0.0013 GHz -> +/-0.004 GHz per point; branch assignment unambiguous for theta < 14.5 deg (lines 13-40 MHz apart, tolerance 7 MHz), ambiguous at the +/-0.03 GHz level for 14.5-19.5 deg (avoided crossings); theta > 23 deg: as the original method (+/-0.5 deg, +/-0.008 GHz; +/-0.02 GHz near crossings and theta > 160 deg)
digitization.overlay_legend: red circles = lower (TM010-like) line, theta <= 23 deg; green circles = upper parallel line; blue circles = TM010-like branch theta > 23 deg (1-deg bins); orange dots = full cloud sample

curves.description: Full simulated mode map point cloud (all eigenmodes between 3 and 6 GHz), sampled at the pixel column nearest every 2 deg; one point per dark-pixel run, so near-degenerate modes (< ~3 px = 0.01 GHz apart) are merged into one point

digitization.method: raster: embedded 1000x1000 bitmap extracted at native resolution via pymupdf; axes calibrated by linear fit to the 8 vertical / 5 horizontal grey grid lines; dark-pixel runs per pixel column; every dark run kept (no mode assignment)
digitization.uncertainty_basis: dot diameter ~2-3 px and 0.5 deg simulation step ~2.4 px -> +/-0.5 deg; +/-2 px dot centroid + calibration -> +/-0.008 GHz on isolated stretches. Near avoided crossings and for theta > ~160 deg (branch merges with flat intruder lines near 3.44-3.46 GHz) the branch assignment itself is uncertain at the +/-0.02 GHz level.

solver_class.reason: Full mode map / off-axis rod (theta > 0) and axles need 3D. Approximately-axisymmetric 2D subcases (the CST model has alumina axles at r = 12.065 mm crossing both gaps, so theta = 0 is NOT exactly axisymmetric; axisymmetric approximation omits axles/endcap holes, systematic ~+2-3 MHz): (a) theta = 0, rod concentric (R = 50.8 mm, r = 25.4 mm, H = 254 mm, h_rod = 253.492 mm, 0.254 mm gaps): TM010-like f = 5.835 GHz (lower of two parallel lines; target 5.83-5.85 +/- 0.015 GHz), C_vac ~0.751 (report C_full too), m = 0 TEM-like lines p c/(2 h_rod), and a gap sweep (G -> 0 recovers coax 5.8666 GHz / C_vac = 0.8062; 1611.07123 G < 250 um statement); Q at theta = 0 (4.6e3) is not a target; (b) empty barrel TM010 Q = 3.07e4 predicted / 2.74e4 measured.

priority_reason: 3D rod sweep with gaps and crossings is the canonical one-rod haloscope benchmark (P1); the theta = 0 concentric-rod-with-gaps (axisymmetric approximation: axles omitted, tolerance +/-0.015 GHz on f, few % on C) and empty-barrel subcases are P0. C010 = 0.4654 and the theta ~ 0 Fig. 6b Q are consistency checks only.
